messages:
Alex: quick q — with the RBAC change that scopes audit exports, what's the minimal proof we must include to satisfy customers who need verifiable signed audit exports? do admins get full events, members get redacted? cc @Ravi
Ravi: short answer: admins should see full tenant events; members only see events for resources they can access. we need a contract for export payload and a visibility matrix.
Maya: +1 on contract. also we should include a `signature_kid` and `signature` so customers can verify with our KMS public key or their own if we support BYOK.
Sophie: also add `audit_schema_version`, `retention_policy`, and `visible_roles` metadata. makes changes explicit.
Alex: example payload i sketched (for discussion):
```json
{
  \"event_id\": \"evt_123\",
  \"ts\": \"2026-03-19T16:12:34Z\",
  \"tenant_id\": \"t-456\",
  \"actor\": \"user:alice@example.com\",
  \"action\": \"model.deploy\",
  \"resource\": \"models/m-789\",
  \"details\": { \"cmd\": \"deploy\", \"version\": \"v2\" },
  \"audit_schema_version\": \"1.0.0\",
  \"visible_roles\": [\"admin\", \"owner\"],
  \"retention_policy\": \"30d\",
  \"signature\": \"base64sig...\",
  \"signature_kid\": \"kms://projects/prod/keys/export-key\"
}
```
Ravi: that looks good. implementation notes:
- for `details` we need to replace sensitive blobs with `\"[REDACTED]\"` for members unless they have explicit resource perms.
- add `redaction_applied: true/false` flag so consumers know whether fields were redacted.
Maya: about KMS: legal asked whether we store exports encrypted with customer KMS or our KMS. we should support both — default to our KMS for self-serve, option for customer-managed keys for Enterprise.
Sophie: chunking spec: if export >1GB, split into chunks and sign each chunk separately; include `chunk_index`, `chunk_count`, and `chunk_checksum`.
sec-bot: [automated] export-request 2067777777 created by Alex — ingestion queued :white_check_mark:
OpsOncall: note — exports are staged to S3 with server-side encryption by default. if customer-KMS enabled, use their KMS key. also ensure we rotate signing keys and publish key history for verification.
Alex: proposed action items:
- Ravi: add contract tests that assert admin vs member visibility matrix (events + field-level redaction)
- Maya: add `signature_kid`, `audit_schema_version`, and BYOK option to export API
- Sophie: define retention metadata and chunking fields in spec
- OpsOncall: document S3/KMS encryption choices and chunking operational runbook
I'll open a PR for the schema and contract tests today.
Sophie: 👍
Ravi: will start the tests this afternoon.
Maya: i'll prototype BYOK flow and share a short draft in #eng-infra.
Alex: thanks all — tagging this for the next security review.
